doctor.headline: playable, 4 warnings
findings: The Shrine is a safe room, where nothing hostile is born, and Brother Amal in playthrough #1000000001 is hostile there -- the player is told nothing hostile is born there, which is still true, but somebody hostile stands in it
this story has no arc, so no playthrough of it can ever reach an ending: there is no quest for a beat to belong to and no outcome to select. A world file's `quests:` block is where one is written
"The Landing" has no layout: nobody can be given a spot in it, so what is within reach there cannot be measured
"The Shrine" has no layout: nobody can be given a spot in it, so what is within reach there cannot be measured
